parsed.rationale: Customer asks for product guidance on how to rename a saved view and where to find the menu/docs; no bug/outage/security/billing/data loss is claimed and urgency is stated as low ('No rush').

parsed.draft_response:
Hi! Happy to help. In most of our apps, saved views can be renamed from the saved views list—look for an overflow menu (⋯) or a “More”/gear icon next to the view, then choose **Rename**. If you don’t see **Rename**, it may be that the view type (or permissions) doesn’t support renaming in your context.

To point you to the exact menu/docs, could you share the following quick details?
1) Which product/app are you using (and whether it’s on web or mobile)?
2) Where you’re currently looking (the exact screen/section name, or a screenshot showing the saved views list)?
3) Does **Rename** appear for any other saved views, or only for this one?

Once I have that, I can direct you to the correct steps or the right documentation page. No rush—reply when convenient.
